headline_is_out_of_sample: n/a -- this is a CENSUS with a pre-declared definition, not a fitted rule. No parameter was chosen to maximise anything; the three free parameters are reported across a 5-point plateau.

F2_mandate_vs_detection.number: mandate causes C01-C05 = 2548 of 2605 = 97.8%; the largest detection-or-later cause is C10_own_regime_gate_off at 26 = 1.0%. Flat across thresholds: 97.7% at +20%, 97.8% at +30%, 97.6% at +50%.

F3_materiality.number: naive per-rally accounting for the top three causes = 1055%/yr of NAV, which is arithmetically impossible (it implies 51x gross in a book capped at 0.80x). Capacity-bounded perfect-foresight ceiling = 87.8%/yr. The only NO-FORESIGHT measurement -- the shipped rule replayed with each cause relaxed one at a time -- is -0.47pp, 0.00pp and -0.43pp over 24 months, i.e. ZERO to NEGATIVE. F3 triggers on the two foresight numbers and does not trigger on the realisable one.

correction: C06_no_detector_fired was originally ordered ahead of the regime gates and mislabelled 8 of 10 rallies whose real cause was the coin's own 200d gate. SleeveA is the RULES sleeve and never consults a detector, so detector coverage is now reported as an independent column, not a funnel step.

deflated_hurdle: 8144 -> 8153 trials; expected_max_sharpe(8153, 9.1y) = 1.4925, deflated hurdle = 0.83 + 1.4925 = 2.3225. Over the 2-year measurement window itself: expected_max_sharpe(8153, 2.0y) = 3.1837, hurdle 4.0137. EVERY book measured here (Sharpe 0.48-0.68) is far below both. NOTHING here is offered as an edge.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_the_study: core_satellite_targets was handed symbol keys (BTCUSDT) while reading base-asset weights (BTC), so the first replayed book held ZERO BTC and ETH and returned +0.48% instead of +12.47%. Caught by cross-checking the BTC rally of 2024-10-22, which the attribution reported as sized-to-zero while BTC was 1.06x above its own 200d MA.
